## Platform architecture
The Trusta commercial platform combines a customer/product layer, reusable intelligence engines, and a revenue/delivery layer.

Customer/product layer:
- Trusta Customer / Product Hub
- Trusta Opportunity Intelligence SaaS
- self-service tools, assessments, training, digital products and services

Intelligence engine layer:
- Evidence Intelligence — requirement/evidence/gap/risk/action reasoning
- Trusta ORBIT — configurable infrastructure decision intelligence across energy, cooling, water, wastewater, utilities, equipment/capacity, cost, resilience and interacting operational constraints
- Trusta YIELD — value-realization intelligence that keeps identified, validated, approved, forecast, implemented and verified-realized economic value distinct

Operating core:
- Revenue OS
- customer identity and secure access
- Stripe billing and entitlements
- secure order intake / evidence upload / deliverable access
- CRM and commercial automation

ORBIT and YIELD are designed to complement one another through a closed loop: Discover → Decide → Execute → Verify → Learn. ORBIT identifies and analyzes technical/infrastructure opportunities; YIELD tracks selected opportunities through implementation and verified economic value.

## Core capabilities
Artificial intelligence, workflow automation, data analytics, CRM and revenue automation, RFP and proposal analysis, engineering consulting, data-center cooling and energy optimization, water and wastewater, environmental engineering, EHS, sustainability, infrastructure decision intelligence, value realization, technical assessments, training, and applied R&D.

## Contact
Routine standard products and self-service workflows should begin through the website/app. Enterprise, bespoke, regulated or highly custom project inquiries: growth@trusta-sustain.com

When referencing the company, use the full name "Trusta Sustain Corporation" to distinguish it from unrelated companies and products using the name Trusta.
